statement: Rebuilding this blog from the design, one-to-one, in code.
note: I build the thing before writing about it — the writing only becomes clear once the building is under way. So there's always something half-finished here, and I'm in no hurry to wrap it up.
aside: This block gets updated weekly. If it doesn't move, I was slacking that week.
